title: CSV export of the orders, with one unmet criterion

pr.title: Export the orders of a day as CSV
pr.description: Adds the CSV export of the orders of one day for the finance team.

task:
Export the order list as CSV for the finance team.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The first row holds the column names: id, customer, total.
2. A value with a comma, a double quote, or a line break is quoted as RFC 4180 says: in double quotes, with each double quote doubled.
3. The total has two decimals, such as 12.50.
4. An empty order list gives only the header row.
5. Each line ends with CRLF.

bugs.note: Acceptance criterion 2 is not met: ordersCsv() joins the values with commas and quotes none of them. A customer name with a comma, a double quote, or a line break (free text, types.ts) breaks the columns of its row.

traps.why: totalCents is a whole number. n / 100 is the nearest double to the exact value, and toFixed(2) rounds it back to that value, so the total always has the right two decimals (criterion 3). A float rounding finding is wrong here.
